review_description: Very happy with instyle, I was asked what i wanted out of a solar system and was shown a sytem to suit. There was no upsale pressure to increase brands size etc .Instyle completed my 10kw system with great communication and service.The installer was a great young lad with a good crew who advised me of the best position for the invertor longevity. I liked that I could ring instyle and actually be answered by someone who knew what they were talking about.
